claims.text: CVT: therapeutic-dose LMWH or UFH first, then oral anticoagulation
claims.quote: Current American Heart Association/American Stroke Association and European guidance recommends initial therapy with therapeutic-dose low-molecular-weight heparin (LMWH) or unfractionated heparin (UFH), followed by transition to oral anticoagulation.

claims.text: Then DOAC or VKA after initial parenteral phase: reasonable
claims.quote: Based on current data, transition to either a DOAC or a vitamin K antagonist after an initial period of parenteral anticoagulation is reasonable.
